infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RoomMuse uses your camera to capture the room you want to redesign.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RoomMuse uses your microphone to include sound when you record a room video.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RoomMuse lets you choose room photos for a design concept.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RoomMuse to scan and photograph your room.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow RoomMuse to record sound with a room video.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RoomMuse to select a room photo.
